"""Instrument planner internals over random instances."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/submission")
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")
import numpy as np
import planner
import gen, gen2, check


def run(reqs, label):
    stats = dict(n=0, opt=0, infeas=0, marg_fail=0, primal_viol=0, farkas_fail=0,
                 worst_viol=0.0, worst_dual_gap=0.0, worst_col=0.0, worst_farkas_mag=0.0,
                 worst_dual_mag=0.0)
    for req in reqs:
        raw = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
        try:
            prob = planner.parse_request(raw)
        except Exception as e:
            print("parse fail", e); continue
        model = planner.Model(prob)
        res = planner._solve_primal(model)
        stats["n"] += 1
        if res.status == 0:
            stats["opt"] += 1
            x = np.asarray(res.x)
            ustar = float(res.fun)
            y = np.asarray(res.ineqlin.marginals, dtype=np.float64).copy()
            q = np.asarray(res.eqlin.marginals, dtype=np.float64).copy() if model.E is not None else np.zeros(0)
            if not planner._dual_ok(model, y, q, ustar):
                stats["marg_fail"] += 1
                alt = planner._dual_of(model)
                ok = alt is not None and planner._dual_ok(model, alt[0], alt[1], ustar, tol_col=1e-8, tol_gap=2e-5)
                if not ok:
                    print("  DUAL FALLBACK FAILED ustar=%r" % ustar, json.dumps(req)[:300])
            # measure quantities
            lhs = model.A.T.dot(y)
            if model.E is not None and q.size:
                lhs = lhs + model.E.T.dot(q)
            stats["worst_col"] = max(stats["worst_col"], float(np.max(lhs - model.c)))
            L = float(model.b.dot(y)) + (float(model.d.dot(q)) if model.d is not None else 0.0)
            stats["worst_dual_gap"] = max(stats["worst_dual_gap"], abs(L - ustar))
            stats["worst_dual_mag"] = max(stats["worst_dual_mag"],
                                          float(np.max(np.abs(y))) if y.size else 0.0,
                                          float(np.max(np.abs(q))) if q.size else 0.0)
            # primal check via full pipeline
            resp = planner.solve(prob)
            if resp["status"] != "optimal":
                print("  pipeline status flip", resp["status"], json.dumps(req)[:200])
            errs = check.check(req, resp, verbose=False)
            if errs:
                print("  CHECK ERRORS", errs, json.dumps(req)[:400])
        elif res.status == 2:
            stats["infeas"] += 1
            cert = planner._farkas(model)
            if cert is None:
                stats["farkas_fail"] += 1
                print("  FARKAS FAILED", json.dumps(req)[:400])
            else:
                y, q = cert
                stats["worst_farkas_mag"] = max(stats["worst_farkas_mag"],
                                                float(np.max(np.abs(y))),
                                                float(np.max(np.abs(q))) if q.size else 0.0)
            resp = planner.solve(prob)
            if resp["status"] != "infeasible":
                print("  pipeline status flip to", resp["status"])
            errs = check.check(req, resp, verbose=False)
            if errs:
                print("  CHECK ERRORS(inf)", errs, json.dumps(req)[:400])
        else:
            print("  weird status", res.status, json.dumps(req)[:200])
    print(label, stats)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3)
    reqs = []
    for i in range(150):
        reqs.append(gen2.gen(rng))
    for i in range(150):
        reqs.append(gen.gen(rng))
    t0 = time.time()
    run(reqs, "mixed")
    print("elapsed", round(time.time() - t0, 2))
